name: get_algorithm_diagnostics
description: Returns the running renderer's compact algorithm diagnostics snapshot: aggregate and per-algorithm health, evaluation-ledger coverage, leakage-safe holdout metrics, bounded Brier-loss attribution by source/domain/horizon/version, forecast resolver coverage and provenance counts, fused market-price history health, weather report freshness/completeness/row validity, p50/p95/max latency, runtime errors, bounded tuning parameters, adjustment proposals, recent evaluations, persistence status, and recent tuning decisions. Raw inputs, notes, details, and input hashes are intentionally omitted.

examples.description: Inspect calibration coverage and identify slow or failing algorithms before tuning
